# Lukenya Ridge

> Lukenya Ridge by Comex Homes (https://www.comexhomes.ke): a planned gated estate of 60 plots of 50 x 100 ft in Lukenya, just off Mombasa Road in Machakos County, about 45 minutes from Nairobi CBD.

- Estate: gated estate concept, 12M and 9M internal roads, 25M wide road frontage, 2,025 m2 community plot, 3M drainage wayleave
- Nearby: Lukenya Hills, Daystar University, Lukenya Girls High School, Kilili Shopping Centre
- Payments: US dollars or Kenya shillings by bank transfer
- Contact: +254 709 501 501 (call or WhatsApp), info@comexhomes.ke
- Brochure: https://www.lukenyaridge.com/Lukenya-Ridge-Catalogue.pdf
